_note: Seed columns offered as add-able SUGGESTIONS in the app, per scope. Nothing here is hard-coded into the engine: every column is user-defined, and these are just convenient starting points for the medaka workflow. Edit freely — remove what you don't use, add your own. The cross-plate registry (annotation_schema.json) also feeds suggestions and grows as you annotate. Column types: categorical | binary | range | free.

incubation_temp_c.hint: e.g. 26 / 28 / 22.6 - autofilled from the frames' median temp_C when available

start_time.hint: imaging start time, autofilled from the first frame timestamp

notes.hint: anything worth recording about the whole plate

mixture.hint: injection mixture (e.g. oca2_ctrl, ctbp1_g1) - a build_db 'mix' key

injection_quality.hint: pre-screen; the real readout is mGOLD intensity later

valid_frames.hint: the good timepoint window on the trajectory (drag on the scrubber)

empty.hint: empty well - defaults to false unless toggled

iwamatsu_stage.hint: Iwamatsu (2004) stage. KEYFRAME column: set a stage on a frame and it holds until the next frame you stage.

slice.hint: the relevant z-slice. KEYFRAME column: set a slice and it holds until the next slice change.
